dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「そろそろ、休憩入れませんか？」
dialogues.en: "I think it's about time for a break?"
dialogues.text: "I think it's about time for a break?"

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「う〜い」
dialogues.en: "Whew..."
dialogues.text: "Whew..."

dialogues.jp:
ともちゃんの提案に、残りのふたりも賛成の声
をあげた。
dialogues.en:
At Tomo-chan's proposal, the other two voiced out in
agreement.
dialogues.text:
At Tomo-chan's proposal, the other two voiced out in
agreement.

dialogues.jp: 「んでは、飲み物でも買ってきますわ」
dialogues.en: "I'd go buy some drinks then."
dialogues.text: "I'd go buy some drinks then."

dialogues.jp: リクエストを取ってから、音楽室を出ていった。
dialogues.en: I took down the orders, and left the music room.
dialogues.text: I took down the orders, and left the music room.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ごほっ、ごほっ……どもです〜。えほっ」
dialogues.en: "*Cough cough...* Thank you~. *cough*"
dialogues.text: "*Cough cough...* Thank you~. *cough*"

dialogues.jp:
まだ風邪が治らないらしく、ことりは今日も咳
をしていた。
dialogues.en:
Kotori was still coughing away today, looks like she hasn't
recovered from her cold.
dialogues.text:
Kotori was still coughing away today, looks like she hasn't
recovered from her cold.

dialogues.jp: 「あい。ふたりとも」
dialogues.en: "And the other two."
dialogues.text: "And the other two."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "Thanks~"
dialogues.text: "Thanks~"

dialogues.jp:
腕に抱えたジュースを取ってもらい、俺も一息
ついた。
dialogues.en:
I gave them the drinks I was holding, and paused slightly
for breath.
dialogues.text:
I gave them the drinks I was holding, and paused slightly
for breath.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、朝倉君……あれ、やりすぎなんじゃな
　いですか？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun... you really don't think that's overdoing it?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun... you really don't think that's overdoing it?"

dialogues.jp: ことりはドアに目を向けた。
dialogues.en: Kotori was looking at the door.
dialogues.text: Kotori was looking at the door.

dialogues.jp:
「いや。あのくらいやらんと。言葉だけじゃ物
　足りないからな」
dialogues.en: "Nah, it's needed. Words won't be enough to repel them."
dialogues.text: "Nah, it's needed. Words won't be enough to repel them."

dialogues.jp:
適当な大きさの張り紙を新たに作って、ドアに
張り付けてある──が、それだけではない。
dialogues.en:
I had made a new, huge poster, and leaned it against the
door-- but that wasn't all.
dialogues.text:
I had made a new, huge poster, and leaned it against the
door-- but that wasn't all.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「だからって、あんなの……」
dialogues.en: "But not only that..."
dialogues.text: "But not only that..."

dialogues.jp:
くすくすと、苦笑気味に笑う。俺もドアに目を
向けた。
dialogues.en:
Kotori giggled, a bit of residue shock still wavering. I
turned to look at the door myself.
dialogues.text:
Kotori giggled, a bit of residue shock still wavering. I
turned to look at the door myself.

dialogues.jp:
そこには、かんぬきがあるのだ。しかも、かな
り立派な。
dialogues.en:
I had put a latch on the door as well. The metal matched the
wooden door quite splendidly.
dialogues.text:
I had put a latch on the door as well. The metal matched the
wooden door quite splendidly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、よく手に入れましたねえ……かんぬき
　なんて」
dialogues.en:
"But it's just amazing that you found one... the latch, I
mean."
dialogues.text:
"But it's just amazing that you found one... the latch, I
mean."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「俺の友達に、変に便利な奴が居てね。そいつ
　を通じて、ゲットした」
dialogues.en:
"I have a friend who's good at producing weird things like
that. I ran into him, and got it from there."
dialogues.text:
"I have a friend who's good at producing weird things like
that. I ran into him, and got it from there."

dialogues.jp: 言うまでもなく、杉並だ。
dialogues.en: Of course, I was talking about Suginami.
dialogues.text: Of course, I was talking about Suginami.

dialogues.jp:
「ま、あれだったら、攻城兵が戦国時代からタ
　イムスリップしてこない限り、安心だろう」
dialogues.en:
"Both ways, unless some siege soldiers from the civil war
time slips into this location, we'd be safe."
dialogues.text:
"Both ways, unless some siege soldiers from the civil war
time slips into this location, we'd be safe."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ふふ、そうですね。そのお友達の人に、お礼
　を言っておいて下さいね」
dialogues.en: "Hehe, I guess so. Please thank that friend on my behalf."
dialogues.text: "Hehe, I guess so. Please thank that friend on my behalf."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Uh...okay."
dialogues.text: "Uh...okay."

dialogues.jp:
と言いつつ、もちろん言わない。何故なら、杉
並だから。
dialogues.en:
Although I said that, of course I wouldn't. It's Suginami,
after all.
dialogues.text:
Although I said that, of course I wouldn't. It's Suginami,
after all.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「駄目ですよ。ちゃんと、言ってくれないと」
dialogues.en: "Don't be like that. Make sure you thank him."
dialogues.text: "Don't be like that. Make sure you thank him."

dialogues.jp:
気のない返事をしたせいか、ことりが笑いなが
ら｛にら／睨｝んできた。
dialogues.en:
Detecting my half-hearted response, Kotori both laughed and
playfully admonished me at the same time.
dialogues.text:
Detecting my half-hearted response, Kotori both laughed and
playfully admonished me at the same time.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そうだ。みっくん、ともちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Ah, by the way, Mik-kun, Tomo-chan."
dialogues.text: "Ah, by the way, Mik-kun, Tomo-chan."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.en: "Yeah?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「前にも言ったと思うけど、日曜日、１０日は、
　私……」
dialogues.en:
"I think I've told you before, this Sunday, the 10th,
I'm..."
dialogues.text:
"I think I've told you before, this Sunday, the 10th,
I'm..."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、うん、ライブに行くんだっけ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, yeah. You're going to that concert."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, yeah. You're going to that concert."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「｛どうけし／道化師｝の」
dialogues.en: ""Clown", right?"
dialogues.text: ""Clown", right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そう。だから、その日は、半日しか練習しな
　いからね」
dialogues.en:
"Yep. So on that day, I'd probably have to take half the day
off from practice..."
dialogues.text:
"Yep. So on that day, I'd probably have to take half the day
off from practice..."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「日曜なんだし、気にしないでよそんなの」
dialogues.en: "It's Sunday after all, don't worry about it too much."
dialogues.text: "It's Sunday after all, don't worry about it too much."

dialogues.jp: みっくんが、苦笑気味に手を振る。
dialogues.en:
Mik-kun laughed a little while waving Kotori's uneasiness
off.
dialogues.text:
Mik-kun laughed a little while waving Kotori's uneasiness
off.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、みっくんだってともちゃんだって、家
　で練習するんでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"Of course you can say that, the two of you can practice at
home, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Of course you can say that, the two of you can practice at
home, right?"

dialogues.jp: その言葉に、３人で笑い合った。
dialogues.en: At those words, the three started giggling.
dialogues.text: At those words, the three started giggling.

dialogues.jp:
黙っていれば分からないはずなのに、わざわざ
言う辺り、ことりって律儀だ。
dialogues.en:
I kept quiet since I didn't really understand, but I guess
it was something to do with Kotori's conscientiousness?
dialogues.text:
I kept quiet since I didn't really understand, but I guess
it was something to do with Kotori's conscientiousness?

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「でも……大丈夫？」
dialogues.en: "But... would it really okay?"
dialogues.text: "But... would it really okay?"

dialogues.jp:
ともちゃんが、分かりやすいくらい心配して眉
を下げる。
dialogues.en: Tomo-chan, understandably worried, raised her eyebrow.
dialogues.text: Tomo-chan, understandably worried, raised her eyebrow.

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「風邪……長引いてるんでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "It'd... probably prolong your cold even more, right?"
dialogues.text: "It'd... probably prolong your cold even more, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「へーきへーきっ！　これしきの事で私の──
　ごほっ、ごほっ」
dialogues.en: "It's fine, fine! My-- *cough cough*"
dialogues.text: "It's fine, fine! My-- *cough cough*"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "...Your?"
dialogues.text: "...Your?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「私の白血球は、風邪に負けるように甘やかし
　ちゃいませんから」
dialogues.en: "My white blood cells won't lose to some cold so easily."
dialogues.text: "My white blood cells won't lose to some cold so easily."

dialogues.jp:
しかし、言ってるそばから咳き込んだりして、
どうにも説得力に欠ける。
dialogues.en:
Having said that in the middle of coughs didn't make it
sound any more convincing.
dialogues.text:
Having said that in the middle of coughs didn't make it
sound any more convincing.

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp:
「でも、そんな事言って、去年、インフルエン
　ザで１週間も休んだじゃない」
dialogues.en:
"But even if you say so, didn't you have to rest one week
for the influenza you had last year?"
dialogues.text:
"But even if you say so, didn't you have to rest one week
for the influenza you had last year?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「い、インフルエンザと風邪は違うよ〜。ねえ、
　朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "I, influenza isn't the same as a cold~ Right, Asakura-kun?"
dialogues.text: "I, influenza isn't the same as a cold~ Right, Asakura-kun?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、なあ。ラーメンとソバくらいの違いは
　あるかな」
dialogues.en: "I guess. Like the difference between ramen and soba."
dialogues.text: "I guess. Like the difference between ramen and soba."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「猫とライオンくらい違いますよ」
dialogues.en: "More like the difference between a cat and a lion."
dialogues.text: "More like the difference between a cat and a lion."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……良く分からんけど」
dialogues.en: "...I'm not so sure about that."
dialogues.text: "...I'm not so sure about that."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「……とにかく、悪化しないよう気をつけてね」
dialogues.en: "...In any case, try not to aggravate it any more."
dialogues.text: "...In any case, try not to aggravate it any more."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Mm."
dialogues.text: "Mm."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp:
「いくら楽しみでも、危ないと思ったら、行か
　ない方がいいよ」
dialogues.en:
"I know you're looking forward to it, but if you think you
can't handle it, maybe you shouldn't go..."
dialogues.text:
"I know you're looking forward to it, but if you think you
can't handle it, maybe you shouldn't go..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん……すまんす。それは無理っす」
dialogues.en: "Ehh... I'm sorry, but I can't do that."
dialogues.text: "Ehh... I'm sorry, but I can't do that."

dialogues.jp:
ことりが困ったように微笑む。するとみっくん
は、何故か相好を崩した。
dialogues.en:
Kotori smiled wistfully. Mik-kun didn't do much more than
give a smiling sigh.
dialogues.text:
Kotori smiled wistfully. Mik-kun didn't do much more than
give a smiling sigh.

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp:
「分かってる。言ってみただけ。だって……こ
　とりって、音楽の事になると、人が変わるも
　んね」
dialogues.en:
"I know, before you even said that. When it comes to music,
you're a different person entirely."
dialogues.text:
"I know, before you even said that. When it comes to music,
you're a different person entirely."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そんな事ないってば。そういう風に見えるだ
　けなんだよ、きっと」
dialogues.en: "That's not true and you know it."
dialogues.text: "That's not true and you know it."

dialogues.jp:
苦笑しつつ首を振って、ことりはすっくと立ち
上がった。
dialogues.en:
Another wistful smile, as Kotori stood up from her seating
position.
dialogues.text:
Another wistful smile, as Kotori stood up from her seating
position.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「さ、練習再開しよっ。……ごほっ」
dialogues.en: "Now, let's restart practice. ...*cough*"
dialogues.text: "Now, let's restart practice. ...*cough*"

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりの友人◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kotori's Friends◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kotori's Friends◆

dialogues.jp:
ことり達の練習。ことりは風邪を引いているし、
今度の日曜には出かけるみたいだった。
dialogues.en:
Practice with Kotori and friends. Despite her cold going on
for longer than it should, she still insisted on going to
her outing this Sunday.
dialogues.text:
Practice with Kotori and friends. Despite her cold going on
for longer than it should, she still insisted on going to
her outing this Sunday.

dialogues.jp: 身体を壊さなければいいのだが。
dialogues.en: She might break down if she continues with this...
dialogues.text: She might break down if she continues with this...
